g.text: WEB04 - Validate and Confirm a Consequential Feature Action
The owning feature identifies consequential actions from its requirements.
WEB04 supplies the interaction; confirmation is not authorization.
choose action and submit current values
show field errors; focus first invalid field
return to form; no request sent
create/preserve operation key; prevent repeat submit
offer retry with the same idempotency key
explain outcome is unconfirmed; do not resubmit
